newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - Washington Post business - Jan 16.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Washington Post business - Jan 16.

text.p: The Washington Post carried the following items on the front page of its business section on January 16:
WASHINGTON - Giant Food Inc cancelled its attempt to hire temporary workers as unions increased pressure on the chain to resolve a 31-day-old strike by Teamsters delivery drivers.
WASHINGTON - A federal grand jury handed up a 45-count criminal indictment against former Archer Daniels Midland Inc executive Mark Whitacre.

NEW YORK - Jesse Jackson's Rainbow/PUSH coalition and the National Organization for Women said they had agreed to call off their consumer boycott of Mitsubishi Motor Manufacturing of America Inc in exchange for a commitment to provide $200 million in business opportunities for minorites and women.
WASHINGTON - Pharmacies are riding a surge in demand for alternative medicines, now the fastest growing segment of the over-the-counter drug market.
